CREATE TABLE `schema_migrations` (
  `step` int NOT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `object_name` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `object_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(8) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `started_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `applied_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`step`),
  CONSTRAINT `schema_migrations_chk_1` CHECK ((`step` >= 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `schema_migrations_chk_2` CHECK ((`state` in (_utf8mb4'applying',_utf8mb4'applied'))),
  CONSTRAINT `schema_migrations_chk_3` CHECK (((`state` = _utf8mb4'applied') = (`applied_at` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `schema_migrations_chk_4` CHECK (regexp_like(`source_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `schema_migrations_chk_5` CHECK (regexp_like(`object_sha256`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{64}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `tenants` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tenants_chk_1` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'disabled'))),
  CONSTRAINT `tenants_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `workspaces` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `workspaces_tenant_id` (`tenant_id`,`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `workspaces_tenant_name` (`tenant_id`,`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `tenants` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_chk_1` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'disabled'))),
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_chk_2` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `workspaces_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_canonical` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_display` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `display_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `is_platform_admin` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `email_verified_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `auth_epoch` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email_canonical` (`email_canonical`),
  KEY `users_list_idx` (`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `users_status_list_idx` (`status`,`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_1` CHECK ((`locale` in (_utf8mb4'en',_utf8mb4'zh-CN'))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_2` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'active',_utf8mb4'disabled'))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_3` CHECK ((`is_platform_admin` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_4` CHECK ((`auth_epoch` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_5` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `users_chk_6` CHECK ((`email_canonical` = lower(`email_canonical`))),
  CONSTRAINT `users_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `password_credentials` (
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `password_phc` varchar(512) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `changed_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `password_credentials_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `password_credentials_chk_1` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `workspace_memberships` (
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `workspace_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`workspace_id`),
  KEY `memberships_scope_idx` (`tenant_id`,`workspace_id`,`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `workspace_memberships_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `workspace_memberships_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `workspace_memberships_chk_1` CHECK ((`role` in (_utf8mb4'owner',_utf8mb4'member',_utf8mb4'viewer'))),
  CONSTRAINT `workspace_memberships_chk_2` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `installation_state` (
  `id` smallint NOT NULL,
  `bootstrap_complete` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `default_workspace_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `primary_admin_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `bootstrapped_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `primary_admin_user_id` (`primary_admin_user_id`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`,`default_workspace_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `installation_state_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `tenants` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `installation_state_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`primary_admin_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `installation_state_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `default_workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `installation_state_chk_1` CHECK ((`id` = 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `installation_state_chk_2` CHECK ((`bootstrap_complete` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `installation_state_chk_3` CHECK ((((`bootstrap_complete` = 1) and (`tenant_id` is not null) and (`default_workspace_id` is not null) and (`primary_admin_user_id` is not null) and (`bootstrapped_at` is not null)) or ((`bootstrap_complete` = 0) and (`tenant_id` is null) and (`default_workspace_id` is null) and (`primary_admin_user_id` is null) and (`bootstrapped_at` is null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `sessions` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `audience` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varbinary(32) NOT NULL,
  `auth_epoch` bigint NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `absolute_expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoke_reason` varchar(48) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `sessions_user_live_idx` (`user_id`,`revoked_at`),
  KEY `sessions_expiry_idx` (`absolute_expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_chk_1` CHECK ((`audience` in (_utf8mb4'portal',_utf8mb4'admin'))),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_chk_2` CHECK ((length(`token_hash`) = 32)),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_chk_3` CHECK ((`auth_epoch` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_chk_4` CHECK ((`absolute_expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_chk_5` CHECK ((`last_seen_at` >= `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_chk_6` CHECK (((`revoked_at` is null) = (`revoke_reason` is null))),
  CONSTRAINT `sessions_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `invitations` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `workspace_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `email_canonical` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varbinary(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_generation` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_by` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `accepted_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `accepted_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `pending_email` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'pending') then `email_canonical` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  UNIQUE KEY `invitations_pending_email_idx` (`pending_email`),
  KEY `invitations_list_idx` (`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `created_by` (`created_by`),
  KEY `accepted_user_id` (`accepted_user_id`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`,`workspace_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`accepted_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_1` CHECK ((`locale` in (_utf8mb4'en',_utf8mb4'zh-CN'))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_10` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'accepted') and (`accepted_user_id` is not null) and (`accepted_at` is not null)) or ((`status` <> _utf8mb4'accepted') and (`accepted_user_id` is null) and (`accepted_at` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_11` CHECK (((`status` = _utf8mb4'revoked') = (`revoked_at` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_2` CHECK ((`role` = _utf8mb4'member')),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_3` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'accepted',_utf8mb4'revoked',_utf8mb4'expired'))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_4` CHECK (((`token_hash` is null) or (length(`token_hash`) = 32))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_5` CHECK ((`token_generation` >= 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_6` CHECK ((`version` between 1 and 9007199254740991)),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_7` CHECK ((`email_canonical` = lower(`email_canonical`))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_8` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_chk_9` CHECK (((`status` = _utf8mb4'pending') = (`token_hash` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `invitations_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `password_reset_tokens` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `audience` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` varbinary(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `consumed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `reset_tokens_id_user` (`id`,`user_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `token_hash` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `reset_tokens_user_live_idx` (`user_id`,`consumed_at`,`revoked_at`,`expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `password_reset_tokens_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `password_reset_tokens_chk_1` CHECK ((`audience` in (_utf8mb4'portal',_utf8mb4'admin'))),
  CONSTRAINT `password_reset_tokens_chk_2` CHECK (((`token_hash` is null) or (length(`token_hash`) = 32))),
  CONSTRAINT `password_reset_tokens_chk_3` CHECK ((`expires_at` > `created_at`)),
  CONSTRAINT `password_reset_tokens_chk_4` CHECK (((`consumed_at` is null) or (`revoked_at` is null))),
  CONSTRAINT `password_reset_tokens_chk_5` CHECK ((((`consumed_at` is null) and (`revoked_at` is null)) = (`token_hash` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `reset_tokens_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `mail_deliveries` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `purpose` varchar(24) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `recipient_email` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `invitation_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `invitation_generation` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `reset_token_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `payload_key_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_nonce` varbinary(12) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_ciphertext` blob,
  `payload_schema_version` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `attempt_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `lease_token` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `locked_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_category` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `message_id` varchar(254) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `completed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `message_id` (`message_id`),
  KEY `mail_claim_idx` (`state`,`next_attempt_at`),
  KEY `mail_list_idx` (`created_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `invitation_id` (`invitation_id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `reset_token_id` (`reset_token_id`,`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`invitation_id`) REFERENCES `invitations` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`reset_token_id`, `user_id`) REFERENCES `password_reset_tokens` (`id`, `user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_1` CHECK ((`purpose` in (_utf8mb4'invitation',_utf8mb4'password_reset',_utf8mb4'password_changed'))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_2` CHECK ((`locale` in (_utf8mb4'en',_utf8mb4'zh-CN'))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_3` CHECK ((`state` in (_utf8mb4'queued',_utf8mb4'sending',_utf8mb4'sent',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'cancelled'))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_4` CHECK ((`payload_schema_version` = 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_5` CHECK ((`attempt_count` between 0 and 5)),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_6` CHECK ((((`purpose` = _utf8mb4'invitation') and (`invitation_id` is not null) and (`invitation_generation` is not null) and (`reset_token_id` is null) and (`user_id` is null)) or ((`purpose` = _utf8mb4'password_reset') and (`reset_token_id` is not null) and (`invitation_id` is null) and (`invitation_generation` is null) and (`user_id` is not null)) or ((`purpose` = _utf8mb4'password_changed') and (`user_id` is not null) and (`invitation_id` is null) and (`invitation_generation` is null) and (`reset_token_id` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_7` CHECK ((((`state` in (_utf8mb4'queued',_utf8mb4'sending')) and (`payload_key_id` is not null) and (`payload_nonce` is not null) and (length(`payload_nonce`) = 12) and (`payload_ciphertext` is not null) and (`completed_at` is null)) or ((`state` in (_utf8mb4'sent',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'cancelled')) and (`payload_key_id` is null) and (`payload_nonce` is null) and (`payload_ciphertext` is null) and (`completed_at` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_chk_8` CHECK ((((`state` = _utf8mb4'sending') and (`lease_token` is not null) and (`locked_until` is not null)) or ((`state` <> _utf8mb4'sending') and (`lease_token` is null) and (`locked_until` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_deliveries_id_canonical` CHECK (regexp_like(`id`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')),
  CONSTRAINT `mail_lease_canonical` CHECK (((`lease_token` is null) or regexp_like(`lease_token`,_utf8mb4'^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$',_utf8mb4'c')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE `audit_events` (
  `id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `occurred_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `actor_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `subject_user_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `workspace_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `audience` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `outcome` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin NOT NULL,
  `target_type` varchar(48) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `request_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `identifier_digest` varbinary(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `metadata` json NOT NULL DEFAULT (json_object()),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `audit_list_idx` (`occurred_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `audit_action_idx` (`action`,`occurred_at` DESC,`id` DESC),
  KEY `actor_user_id` (`actor_user_id`),
  KEY `subject_user_id` (`subject_user_id`),
  KEY `tenant_id` (`tenant_id`,`workspace_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`subject_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `tenants` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`, `workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces` (`tenant_id`, `id`),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_chk_1` CHECK ((`audience` in (_utf8mb4'portal',_utf8mb4'admin',_utf8mb4'operator',_utf8mb4'system'))),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_chk_2` CHECK ((`outcome` in (_utf8mb4'success',_utf8mb4'failure',_utf8mb4'accepted'))),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_chk_3` CHECK (((`identifier_digest` is null) or (length(`identifier_digest`) = 32))),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_chk_4` CHECK (((`workspace_id` is null) or (`tenant_id` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `audit_events_chk_5` CHECK ((json_type(`metadata`) = _utf8mb4'OBJECT')),
